title: Will It Survive? Deciphering the Fate of AI Agent-Authored Code in Open Source
abstract: arXiv:2601.16809v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI coding agents such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex and Devin now open pull requests (PRs) that are merged into open-source projects. Industry reports suggest that AI-assisted code is revised or reverted soon after it is written, which raises the concern that agent code is "disposable". However, little is known about what happens to agent code after it is merged. Knowing how long this code survives, and why it is changed, can help maintainers decide how much review it needs. We performed a survival analysis of the 648,959 lines that 2,794 merged PRs added outside vendored and generated paths in 215 open-source repositories from the AIDev dataset, comparing agent-attributed and human code within the same repositories. Agent-attributed code is not modified sooner than human code. When each PR is weighted equally, agent-attributed lines are modified later (HR = 0.83, 95% CI [0.75, 0.93]). This difference comes from the supervise

translated_title: 它会存活吗？解读开源项目中AI智能体编写代码的命运
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.16809v2 通告类型：replace-cross 摘要：诸如GitHub Copilot、OpenAI Codex和Devin等AI编程智能体如今可以发起被合并进开源项目的拉取请求（PR）。行业报告显示，AI辅助编写的代码在写完后往往很快就会被修改或回滚，这引发了人们对智能体代码是“一次性的”这一担忧。然而，关于智能体代码在被合并之后究竟发生了什么，人们知之甚少。了解这些代码能够存活多久、以及它为何被修改，可以帮助维护者决定需要对其进行多少审查。我们对来自AIDev数据集的215个开源仓库中2,794个已合并PR在排除第三方和自动生成路径之后新增的648,959行代码进行了生存分析，并在相同仓库内比较了归因于智能体的代码与人类编写的代码。结果表明，归因于智能体的代码并不比人类代码更早被修改。当每个PR权重相同时，归因于智能体的代码行被修改的时间反而更晚（HR = 0.83，95% CI [0.75, 0.93]）。这一差异来自于监督……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过对215个开源仓库中约65万行代码的生存分析发现，AI智能体编写的代码并不比人类代码更快被修改，甚至在同等条件下存活时间更长，从而有力反驳了“智能体代码是一次性的”这一担忧。
en_tdlr: Through a survival analysis of nearly 650K lines of code across 215 open-source repositories, this study finds that AI agent-authored code is not modified sooner than human code—and may even survive longer—challenging the concern that agent code is "disposable."
